constraints.area_constrained_seed_semantics: all skin faces with at least one exact Run029 159 crossing pair

solver.method: Global SCP using frozen Run033 first-union targets for the Run032 best partial start, graph-Laplacian soft targets, exact source/trust/exit projections, oriented-area guards, dynamic sparse self-pair barriers, and the verified P090 batched projector. Every accepted iterate passes a fresh exact self audit, complete exact 185-bank point audit, and P089 construction-progress merit (strict typed-pair reduction with nonincreasing maximum and squared penetration depth). Newly introduced shallow pairs are retained.

limitations: Construction geometry only. Finite ADMM partial iterates are proposal-only; convergence is not an acceptance criterion. Every backtracking trial is saved before gating. Frozen Run033 first-union targets cover all 1,239 Run032-start inside query rows. Each accepted step passes exact self and fresh complete 185-bank point audits plus P089 strict count/depth merit; introduced typed pairs are allowed and recorded. If a newly inside query row lacks a frozen target, the run stops with a retarget-required status. The matched Run032 surface crossing-pair count is 4,156 and seeds oriented-area guards; later face counts are not directly comparable after geometry changes. The result has no anatomical, material, physical, or native admission.
